booking.chatGreeting: Hi, I'm {{name}}! Feel free to ask me anything before you book.
booking.chatDisclaimer: Your message is sent directly to your caregiver — they'll reply from their dashboard.
booking.chatReply1: Sure, I can help with that. Let me know your preferred schedule!

checkout.title: Complete payment
checkout.subtitle: Secured by Razorpay (simulated for this prototype).
checkout.successMessage: A WhatsApp confirmation and invoice have been sent to your registered number.

chatbot.faqPricing: Pricing depends on the service — most categories start around ₹250–350/hr. You can see exact rates on each service page under "Pricing".
chatbot.faqServices: We offer Aged Care, Personal Care, Nursing Services, Domestic Assistance, and Social Companionship & Travel Assistance. Browse all of them under "Care Type & Services".
chatbot.faqBooking: To book: log in with your phone number, pick a service, fill in your address and schedule, and we'll match you with an available caregiver.
chatbot.faqPayment: Payments are handled securely via Razorpay — UPI, cards, and netbanking are all supported. You'll get a WhatsApp confirmation after payment.
chatbot.faqCancel: To cancel or request a refund on a booking, please reach out to our support team — they can process it from their end.
chatbot.faqCaregiver: All our caregivers are background-verified and trained for their specific care category before being listed on the platform.
chatbot.greeting: Hi! I'm the {{brand}} assistant. Ask me about pricing, services, or how booking works.
chatbot.fallbackAnswer: I don't have an answer for that yet. Would you like me to connect you with a human support agent?
chatbot.escalationMessage: Connecting you to a human support agent — someone will respond here shortly.

panic.alertSentMessage: Our support team and your emergency contact have been notified with your last known location. Stay safe — someone will reach out shortly.
panic.confirmMessage: This will immediately notify {{brand}} support and your registered emergency contact that you need help. Only use this in a genuine emergency.

process.title: Three steps to the right carer
process.step1Body: Pick a care type, a schedule and your locality. It takes under two minutes.
process.step2Body: We surface verified caregivers ranked by rating, experience and distance from you.
process.step3Body: Confirm, pay securely, and track every visit with OTP check-in and check-out.
